newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Primakov ill, to have gallstone operation.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Primakov ill, to have gallstone operation.

text.p: Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov was taken to hospital on Friday to have an operation to remove a gallstone, a ministry spokesman said.
"It was rather unexpected", the spokesman said, adding that it was not clear when the surgery would take place.
Primakov, 66, missed a scheduled meeting with Portugese Foreign Minister Jaime Gama on Friday.

It was not immediately clear whether his sudden illness would affect the tough talks between Moscow and NATO over the Western defence alliance's plans to expand eastwards. The Russian minister has played an important role in the talks.
